about_the_game:
Drive fast and take care of adorable folks!

Highway to Heal is an arcade driving-adventure game in an open world city of a sustainable near-future. Take the wheel of an ambulance to help the residents.
📢 Make your siren blare to bring in your patients safe and sound in record time!
🩹 Provide first-aid even while driving!
⛈️ Face storms, traffic and the whims of your patients!

Leap into the action of an extraordinary paramedic duo!

You’ll be assigned exciting missions to save patients in distress. From the Ambulance Center, hit the roads of the hectic open world of Le Mascaret! Dodge traffic jams, zigzag between accidents and exploit audacious shortcuts.

When you reach them, the challenge continues: stabilize their vital signs through quick and intuitive mini-games (immobilisation, disinfection, injection, ...). Is your patient’s health degrading en route? No problem, administer treatments as you drive! Precision and a cool head will be your allies as you keep your patients healthy while you transport them…

Improvisation, adaptation and determination will be your watchwords to triumph over obstacles and save lives. So put on your uniform, switch on the siren and prove that nothing can stop you!

Discover a greener future where local community is key!

After a huge crisis and revolution, citizens are now rebuilding a world step by step by empowering local communities. They are your patients and they have a lot of stories to tell about this new world in the making.

Work as a team and become a valuable part of the city

Visit the various city services available to assist you on your mission: repair and customize your ambulance in a Garage with various unlockable upgrades, choose your treatment tools in a Pharmacy and access the city's most reliable traffic information in the neighborhood’s Town Hall.

Do your best to eventually move up the ranks! You'll obtain the trust of your peers and will be allowed to use more advanced tools!

Features

🧑‍⚕️ Dozens of rescue missions,
🩹 Multiple medical care gestures to treat your patients during missions,
👥 Many characters with their own personal stories to discover.
🏛️ A large handmade open-world European inspired city to explore,
🚑 Many ambulance upgrade collectibles to find through the city,
💊 Customizable vehicle and medical equipmen.

short_description: Head off on an adventure with Jakub & Mishra, the paramedic duo of Highway to Heal, an ambulance driving game. Set in the solarpunk city of Le Mascaret, face traffic, patients whims, storms and more. The clock is ticking! 🚑💨
